versions.changelog:
Initial beta release: RocketMQ read-only inspection for Alibaba Cloud

- Provides read-only batch health inspection for Alibaba Cloud RocketMQ (classic 4.x & 5.x serverless).
- Gathers metrics from cloud monitoring (CMS) and RocketMQ management APIs using aliyun CLI in plugin mode.
- Outputs a scored Markdown health report with instance summaries, quotas, consumer lag/backlogs, DLQ growth, and warnings.
- Includes single-group deep-dive diagnosis, regional quota status, and per-instance/consumer-group detail.
- Enforces strict read-only operation by limiting API calls to non-mutating actions.
- Requires Aliyun CLI >=3.3.3 and specific plugins; includes preflight and threshold configuration setup.
